business_problem: Nanxiang Impression City MEGA needed to make a massive, complex shopping-center parking environment easier to navigate and more commercially effective by solving low parking intelligence, weak reservation and guidance capabilities, and the 'last mile' between driving and in-mall navigation.
solution_summary: Baidu Maps and Nanxiang Impression City MEGA built an intelligent parking system that unifies parking guidance with indoor commercial navigation. The deployment combines parking information publication, parking guidance, smart parking services, and a parking-management platform so parking data, software services, and on-site hardware share one operational center. Drivers can reserve spaces through Baidu Maps or receive automatic space assignment at entry, then continue from outdoor navigation directly into indoor parking guidance without switching tools. Once parked, the same platform supports indoor navigation to stores, AR walking guidance, reverse car-finding, and one-click payment. Under the hood, the system coordinates a 3,000-space facility, links customer-facing navigation with operational management, and extends the parking workflow into an end-to-end 'parking plus shopping' space experience. That lets the mall treat parking as part of commercial conversion, not just traffic handling.

solution_components.name: Baidu Maps Smart Parking Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the end-user navigation and reservation experience across outdoor and indoor parking journeys.

solution_components.name: Parking Information Publication
solution_components.role: Publishes parking availability and related operational information into the shared service flow.

solution_components.name: Parking Guidance
solution_components.role: Directs vehicles to assigned or reserved spaces and connects the parking workflow to store navigation.

solution_components.name: Smart Parking Services
solution_components.role: Enable reservations, automatic space allocation, reverse car-finding, and payment services for drivers.

solution_components.name: Parking Management Platform
solution_components.role: Connects data, hardware, and operations so the mall can manage parking and in-space services as one system.

data_flow: Parking availability and facility data are published into the management platform, then exposed through Baidu Maps for reservation or automatic space assignment. Drivers move from outdoor routing to indoor vehicle guidance, after which store navigation, AR walking routes, reverse car-finding, and payment all operate on the same shared location and parking dataset.
business_outcome: Nanxiang Impression City turned parking into a higher-conversion customer journey, improved traffic turnover, and created a retail experience where navigation, parking, and shopping services work together instead of as isolated systems.
architecture_clues: The project unifies outdoor navigation, indoor parking guidance, indoor store routing, reverse car-finding, and payment in one experience.
The management platform treats parking hardware and software data as a shared operational layer.
The system is positioned as 'parking plus scene' intelligent-space infrastructure rather than only a parking tool.
